**Finding: compliant** (rule T4C — Termination for convenience)

- **Customer right:** § 14 (p0079) lets Client terminate at any time on written notice, with services ending the last day of the month following the notice month (~30–60 days) and **no early-termination fee**. This meets the preferred position.
- **Vendor right:** § 13 (p0078) sets a 1-year auto-renewing term; TrueLink has **no mid-term convenience right**. Its only no-cause exit is mutual non-renewal 30 days before term end — an end-of-term exit of the kind the fallback tolerates. The Sections 2/3 cut-off in p0078 is breach/regulatory-triggered, not convenience.
- **Noted, not flagged:** no express pro-rata refund of prepaid fees (largely moot — fees are invoiced monthly in arrears under § 5a), and 30-day rather than 90-day non-renewal notice, which is symmetric and equally benefits us.

No redline proposed.
